# shadowbank-screen

> Screen wire activity against the findings in FinCEN's November 23, 2026 Financial Trend Analysis on Iranian shadow banking: bank-location routes to the UAE, Hong Kong companies banking in mainland China, UAE free-zone and Marshall Islands or BVI companies at shared addresses, and, for many companies, little to no web presence, opaque ownership, co-location or recent incorporation; multimillion wires with missing or incomplete source-of-funds information, or a mismatch with the line of business, bursts, no operating expenses, and shared counterparties tested against chance with a hypergeometric tail. Clusters flagged parties, estimates activity not yet attributed with chain ladder (FinCEN cited Friedland's chapter; Mack (1993) standard errors are this tool's choice), and back-tests each check with Wilson intervals. Standard library only; no network calls. Engineering checklist, not legal advice.

Every finding names the FTA page it comes from. Geography alone never puts a wire up for review. Tested on synthetic data only.

Built and maintained by Art Akopian, CEO of Banrox (https://banrox.com).

## Docs

- [README.md](https://github.com/BanroxArt/shadowbank-screen/blob/main/README.md): Why, worked example, dispositions, networks, attribution lag, limits.
- [docs/codes.md](https://github.com/BanroxArt/shadowbank-screen/blob/main/docs/codes.md): Every finding code, family, severity, trigger and source; default thresholds.
- [docs/format.md](https://github.com/BanroxArt/shadowbank-screen/blob/main/docs/format.md): Wire, entity, ledger, registry, case and label formats.
- [docs/sources.md](https://github.com/BanroxArt/shadowbank-screen/blob/main/docs/sources.md): Primary sources and what is this tool's own.
- [SKILL.md](https://github.com/BanroxArt/shadowbank-screen/blob/main/SKILL.md): Agent skill for running a review.

## Source

- [screen.py](https://github.com/BanroxArt/shadowbank-screen/blob/main/src/shadowbank/screen.py): Checks and dispositions.
- [network.py](https://github.com/BanroxArt/shadowbank-screen/blob/main/src/shadowbank/network.py): Counterparty overlap, hypergeometric test, clusters.
- [develop.py](https://github.com/BanroxArt/shadowbank-screen/blob/main/src/shadowbank/develop.py): Triangles, chain ladder (Friedland, as cited by FinCEN), Mack (1993) standard errors (this tool's choice).
- [calibrate.py](https://github.com/BanroxArt/shadowbank-screen/blob/main/src/shadowbank/calibrate.py): Per-code precision and recall, disposition sweep.
- [normalize.py](https://github.com/BanroxArt/shadowbank-screen/blob/main/src/shadowbank/normalize.py): Name keys, building keys, purpose categories, free-zone markers.
- [codes.py](https://github.com/BanroxArt/shadowbank-screen/blob/main/src/shadowbank/codes.py): Code registry and sources.
